question.text: NAV of a Cat III AIF unit must be calculated:

answer.text: Per Cat III AIF, irrespective of class/sub-class of units
Separately for each class of units or a Series of units, rounded up to four decimal places

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, NAV per unit is calculated separately for each class/sub-class or Series and rounded up to four decimal places. The Trap: Single NAV or infrequent NAV computations are non-compliant. Cross-Exam Context: Serves differential-rights framework under SEBI norms. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Check the PPM carefully to note how classes/series are structured — this drives investor-specific NAV.
